reported_data.population: Post-checkpoint-inhibitor advanced malignancies; 15 patients completed DLT evaluation and had at least one post-baseline assessment across the mixed dose-escalation cohort. The NSCLC-specific denominator was not disclosed.
reported_data.efficacy: One fourth-line NSCLC patient had an initial pseudoprogression followed by complete resolution of target lesions. Across all tumor types, three responses occurred among 15 evaluable patients; at 3.0 and 10.0 mg/kg the aggregate ORR was 33% (2/6 evaluable).
reported_data.safety: No DLTs were observed. All treatment-related adverse events were grade 1 or 2 except one asymptomatic grade 3 lipase increase.
reported_data.follow_up: Response duration for the NSCLC patient was not reported in the company clinical release; follow-up therefore remains immature.

reported_data.safety: No DLTs were observed. All treatment-related adverse events were grade 1 or 2 except one asymptomatic grade 3 lipase increase.

reported_data.efficacy: One heavily pretreated HL patient achieved a partial metabolic response after prior ABVD, BEAM/autologous transplant, nivolumab and brentuximab. Across all tumor types, three responses occurred among 15 evaluable patients; at 3.0 and 10.0 mg/kg the aggregate ORR was 33% (2/6 evaluable).
reported_data.safety: No DLTs were observed. All treatment-related adverse events were grade 1 or 2 except one asymptomatic grade 3 lipase increase.
reported_data.follow_up: The HL response was ongoing at 7.5+ months at the ASCO 2026 disclosure.

competitor_comparisons.matched_setting: Heavily pretreated advanced NSCLC in a phase 1 cohort; median three prior regimens, providing a maturity-matched later-line benchmark although the mechanism and eligibility differ.
competitor_comparisons.clinical_comparison: Datopotamab deruxtecan produced a 26% objective response rate in 50 patients, median response duration of 10.5 months and median progression-free survival of 6.9 months. The CTX-8371 NSCLC response is clinically encouraging, but one responder without a target-specific denominator or disclosed duration cannot yet establish comparable response reliability.
competitor_comparisons.limitations: Cross-trial comparison; different target, treatment, eligibility and response-assessment timing. The CTX-8371 result comes from a mixed-tumor dose-escalation cohort.

competitor_comparisons.matched_setting: Relapsed or refractory metastatic TNBC after at least two prior chemotherapy regimens; a later-line benchmark, though not all patients were selected for prior checkpoint-inhibitor exposure and the modality differs.
competitor_comparisons.clinical_comparison: Sacituzumab govitecan achieved a 35% objective response rate, median progression-free survival of 5.6 months and median overall survival of 12.1 months in the randomized study. The CTX-8371 response depth and 10.5+ month ongoing duration are notable, but a single response with no TNBC-specific denominator is insufficient to infer a cohort-level response rate.
competitor_comparisons.limitations: Cross-trial comparison across a randomized phase 3 antibody-drug conjugate study and a phase 1 bispecific dose-escalation cohort; prior-treatment composition and sample size differ materially.

competitor_comparisons.matched_setting: Heavily pretreated relapsed or refractory classical HL after chemotherapy, brentuximab and PD-1 pathway therapy; a close disease-line benchmark but with a cell-therapy combination rather than bispecific monotherapy.
competitor_comparisons.clinical_comparison: Initial phase 2 LuminICE-203 data reported a 90% objective response rate with 60% complete responses among 10 evaluable patients. The 7.5+ month CTX-8371 metabolic response supports activity after multiple prior therapies, but the undisclosed HL denominator prevents comparison with the high cohort-level response benchmark.
competitor_comparisons.limitations: Cross-trial comparison with different mechanism, combination regimen, sample size and response-assessment schedule; both datasets are early and nonrandomized.
